title: selinum pollichii
intro: Selinum pollichii, commonly known as Wild Celery, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family, Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selinum pollichii include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
